configuration.class_weights: balanced for Logistic Regression and Random Forest; inverse-frequency sample weights for XGBoost
configuration.preprocessing: strict finite numeric schema; Fwd Header Length.1 verified and removed

dataset_memory_estimate.estimate_method: sample DataFrame memory scaled to rows; 4x factor for split arrays, scaling, and model working copies

limitations: Test rows are drawn from a per-class capped sample, not the natural dataset prevalence.
Exact duplicate rows are grouped, but related/near-duplicate flows can cross partitions.
The cleaned CSV has no capture-file provenance, so scenario-held-out evaluation is unavailable.
result_scope: class-capped subset; metrics are not estimates for the natural CIC-IDS2017 population
